references.title: DWDS: tun
references.supports: Sense 7, ⟨mit jmdm., etw. nichts zu tun haben (= in keiner Beziehung zu jmdm., etw. stehen)⟩: mit belongs to the expression, and DWDS lists no zu tun haben of its own. The authored definition, an input to segment.inConstituents, never graded, follows this sense

references.title: en.wiktionary: zu tun haben
references.supports: zu tun haben, 'to be busy, to have work to do', beside 'to have to do with', +mit

notes.rationale: Flat: zu tun haben alone means 'be busy', not this Reading's 'have to do with', so it is no inner unit. A run inside a wording is one part only when it keeps the meaning it has inside the whole, and the definition, not the emoji, carries that test (ADR 0050, the user on #1241, 2026-10-30). The placeholder etwas is never a part, so the parts are mit, the infinitive PART zu (de/bare-infinitive-zu), tun and haben. From tf-demo's request 12fbda85, Vielleicht hatte es damit zu tun, dass …
